items.a: Yes. The Free plan gives you unlimited marketplace browsing, a watchlist, and direct messaging — no card required, ever.
Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or switch between Buyer Pro and Seller Pro at any time from this page.
Paid plans are billed monthly, starting the moment your subscription is confirmed at checkout.
Yes, any time. You keep access to your paid features until the end of the billing period you already paid for.
Visa, Mastercard, and American Express cards are supported at checkout.

items.q: What happens to my data if I downgrade?
items.a: Nothing is deleted. Your listings, watchlist, messages, and history stay intact — you simply lose access to plan-specific features like AI analysis or featured placement.
